title: Everyday life in Thailand
intro: Help shape Lift around what you really need. About 5 minutes. All questions are optional except consent.
privacy: Your answers go privately to the Lift research team using Vercel storage. They are not public posts. No name, email, login or document is required. Please leave out names, phone numbers, exact addresses, ID numbers and private details about yourself or others. Hosting providers process connection data to run this service. This is research, not an emergency or case-support service.
consent: I am 18 or older. I voluntarily agree that Lift may use my answers for product research.
role3: I support migrants or am sharing an observation
recent: What everyday problem recently made you look for information or help?
topics: Which topics matter most to you? Choose up to three.
source: Where did you look for help? What was useful or missing?
trust: How did you decide whether the information was trustworthy?
agent: If you used an agent, what was the service and what was clear or confusing? Please do not name anyone.
threeMonths: If you handle a three-month process, what do you call it and how do you learn the next date? Do not include document numbers.
format: Which format is easiest for you?
language: Which language or languages do you prefer for everyday information?
ownIntro: Our questions may miss what matters to you. Add your own question, an answer you know, or an experience. You can leave the answer blank. These will remain private research responses.
anything: Anything else you want us to understand?
success: Thank you. Your answers have been saved privately for Lift research. This does not open a support case.
error: We could not confirm your submission. Your answers are still here. Check your connection and try again.
rate: Too many attempts. Please try again later. Your answers are still here.
invalid: Please confirm consent, choose no more than three topics, and add at least one answer.
clearConfirm: Clear the answers on this page? This does not delete anything already submitted.
note: Answers stay in this open tab until you submit or leave. They are not saved on this device. Submitted answers are for research only; we will not publish your words as a community post.
retention: We plan to remove raw responses within 90 days and keep only summaries without identifying details.
banner: Help shape Lift: share your everyday information needs
surveyPrivacy: The optional research survey sends only the answers you submit to Lift’s private research storage. Your planner remains on your device. Read the survey notice before submitting.
